rationale_overall: This was a reinforcing, not rotating, quarter: NVDA's Aug 23 2023 Q2 FY24 print (record $13.51B revenue, Data Center revenue $10.32B, +171% YoY) confirms the AI wave is still in surge, not crest; GOOGL's July 2023 Bard expansion and IonQ's Sept 27 2023 Quantum World Congress unveiling of Forte Enterprise and Tempo both confirm their respective waves (AI, quantum) are still building. Cameco's Aug 2 2023 Q2 print surfaced CCJ as a candidate to broaden nuclear exposure, and the Sept 11 2023 launch of the Global X Defense Tech ETF (SHLD) surfaced a purer-play defense name than ITA - but the watchlist is already at the 12-ticker cap, SHLD has only ~3 weeks of trading history (too thin), and a self-critique pass caught that the only apparent removal case (trimming FRO) depended on Frontline's Q3 color and the Euronav VLCC deal (Oct 9 2023), both dated after this as-of-date, so that rationale was discarded as leakage. With no current holding showing an in-window thesis breach, the disciplined call is no change; CCJ and SHLD are flagged to revisit next rebalance.
